summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K announcing a milestone: it has shipped over five million coherent photonic integrated circuits (PICs) in partnership with Marvell Technology. No financial terms, stake percentages, or deal structure are disclosed. The filing describes collaborative advancement of silicon photonics platforms for AI-driven data center connectivity. There is no transaction, board action, or regulatory process involved. This is an ordinary operational and marketing update, not a special situation event.
